You may also obtain a new status in the U.S. through approval of a change of status application by USCIS.

args.quote: Full-time status is defined by the Registrar and varies by campus (Morningside Registrar | CUIMC Registrar). Most often, it is either a minimum of 12 credit points or one resident unit.
